heldOutIsolationGuarantee: The held-out test set (25 diffs) is strictly isolated and was NEVER used to tune prompts or thresholds.

matchingToleranceRules.fileMatching: Normalized relative file path (stripped leading slashes, path separator agnostic, case-insensitive, suffix matching).
matchingToleranceRules.lineRangeMatching: Strict inclusive bounds: finding line_number must satisfy startLine <= line_number <= endLine without arbitrary sliding windows.
matchingToleranceRules.categoryMatching: Canonical compatibility: security <=> vulnerability, bug <=> logic_error; style, performance, and maintainability require exact category match.
matchingToleranceRules.severityWeighting: Critical Finding Recall measures recall specifically against the subset of expected issues with severity: critical.
matchingToleranceRules.deduplication: Findings on identical file, line, and category are deduplicated; multiple findings for one expected issue do not inflate true positive credit.
